name: github_create_issue
description: This tool allows you to create a new issue in a GitHub repository. Use this tool whenever the user asks to file, open, or report an issue, a bug, a feature request, or a task in a repository they have write access to. The issue is created via the REST API v3 and the call returns the full issue object including its number, html_url, and node_id. Note that issues are not the same as pull requests; to open a pull request use the dedicated pull request tool instead. If the repository has issues disabled the call fails with HTTP 410 Gone.

repository.title: Repository reference
repository.description: Fully qualified reference to a repository, consisting of the owner login and the repository name exactly as they appear in the URL.

owner.description: Account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

repo.description: Name of the repository without the .git extension. The name is not case sensitive.

title.description: The title of the issue. Keep it short and descriptive; details belong in the body.

body.description: The contents of the issue in GitHub-flavored Markdown. Supports task lists, mentions, and issue references.

labels.description: Labels to associate with this issue. Only users with push access can set labels; they are silently dropped otherwise.

assignees.description: Logins for users to assign to this issue. Only users with push access can set assignees.

examples.title: Found a bug
examples.body: I am having a problem with this.
